raw_resume.summary: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering graduate (2025) with hands-on experience building full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React. Seeking a Software Development Engineer II role to apply strong fundamentals in backend systems, APIs, and testing in a production environment.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks for created, captured and refunded states. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the app with Docker.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Designed and implemented a Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms; piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students and eliminated double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status, deployed locally with Docker Compose.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain 3+ years of professional software development experience at a company; this role requires non-internship professional tenure you do not yet have.
Study and apply design patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy) in your projects and document them in project READMEs or code comments to demonstrate pattern knowledge.

Implement algorithmic problem-solving: solve 50+ LeetCode-style problems (arrays, trees, graphs, dynamic programming) and add a 'Algorithms & Problem-Solving' section to your portfolio or GitHub README.
Contribute to open-source projects or peer code reviews on GitHub to build a track record of code review practices and collaborative development.

Explore distributed systems concepts (eventual consistency, CAP theorem, message queues) through a hobby project (e.g. a multi-service order system with RabbitMQ or Kafka) and document the architecture.
raw_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals, but this role requires 3+ years of professional non-internship experience and 2+ years of systems design and architecture work. You do not yet meet the basic qualifications. Focus on landing your first professional role as a Software Engineer, then revisit SDE II roles after 3+ years of production experience.
